## Data safety

- Characters, chats, lorebooks and API keys live in the app-private data directory (`data / extensions / plugins`), fully separate from the Tavern source tree that every upgrade re-extracts.
- On the first launch after an upgrade, `data / extensions / plugins` are hardlink-snapshotted before those assets are refreshed (last 2 snapshots kept).
- In-place installs keep app data. Do not uninstall, and do not install a build with a different signature.
